title: evolvulus glomeratus var. desertorum
intro: Evolvulus glomeratus var. desertorum, commonly known as Dwarf Blue Daze, is a low-growing, flowering plant species in the family Convolvulaceae. This plant is known for its vibrant blue flowers and compact growth habit, making it a popular ornamental choice. The health benefits of Evolvulus glomeratus var. desertorum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, anti-anxiety, and antimicrobial effects.
